content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the given molecule (product) reproduces the DIBAL-H reduction: carbonyl ester reduced to aldehyde, also carbonyl double bond order change from 2 to 1 (C=O to C-OH). The product SMILES given is C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO. This appears to be a cyclic acetal? Actually contains an aldehyde (CC=O) inside ring? The product includes an aldehyde group (CC=O) attached to ring. The precursor likely is the corresponding ester: maybe C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO? Wait DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, so precursor is ester. So we need a template that breaks a carbon-oxygen bond (C=O of ester) and changes bond order from double to single (forming alcohol). The template ID we need to find via search. We tried searching with functional_groups_broken carboxylic esters and formed aldehydes/aliphatic hydroxyls but got empty. Maybe need to search without functional_groups_formed? Let's search just broken carboxylic esters.
